## What Is LungFresh?

LungFresh is a daily respiratory supplement formulated with six key evidence-informed ingredients: N-Acetyl Cysteine (NAC), Quercetin, Bromelain, Cordyceps Mushroom Extract, Vitamin C, and Ivy Leaf Extract. Each ingredient is selected to address a specific pathway in airway health — from antioxidant protection to mucus clearance to anti-inflammatory support.

## How LungFresh Works

LungFresh targets respiratory health through three complementary mechanisms:

1. **Antioxidant protection** — Neutralizes free radicals (from pollution, allergens, and environmental toxins) that damage delicate bronchial tissue and impair cilia function. NAC and Vitamin C are primary antioxidant contributors.

2. **Mucolytic support** — NAC and Bromelain work through separate pathways to thin excess mucus, making it easier for the body to clear airways naturally. Clearer airways mean more direct airflow and less congestion sensation.

3. **Anti-inflammatory action** — Quercetin and Cordyceps extract help reduce chronic low-grade inflammation in airway tissue, calming the reactivity to seasonal allergens, dust, and environmental irritants that makes breathing uncomfortable.

## Key Ingredients

- **N-Acetyl Cysteine (NAC)** — Precursor to glutathione; mucolytic and antioxidant. Research on [NIH PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/).
- **Quercetin** — Anti-inflammatory flavonoid with antihistamine-like properties for seasonal airway support.
- **Bromelain** — Pineapple-derived enzyme with expectorant and mucus-thinning activity. FDA GRAS status.
- **Cordyceps Mushroom Extract** — Supports cellular oxygen utilization efficiency during physical activity.
- **Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid)** — Collagen synthesis and water-soluble antioxidant in airway fluid lining.
- **Ivy Leaf Extract** — Traditional European herbal ingredient for bronchial comfort and mucus management.

## Scientific Context

The [National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI)](https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/lungs) identifies oxidative stress and chronic airway inflammation as primary contributors to declining respiratory comfort in adults. LungFresh's formula is designed to address these identified mechanisms through natural, non-GMO ingredients.

Additional research references:
- [NIH National Library of Medicine](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/) — peer-reviewed pulmonary research
- [NIH PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/) — NAC mucolytic and antioxidant studies
- [NIH ODS — Vitamin C](https://ods.od.nih.gov/factsheets/VitaminC-HealthProfessional/) — pulmonary antioxidant defense
- [FDA Dietary Supplements](https://www.fda.gov/food/dietary-supplements) — regulatory context for ingredients

## Common Questions

**Who is LungFresh for?** Adults seeking natural support for respiratory comfort, particularly those dealing with morning airway congestion, seasonal breathing difficulty, reduced exercise breathing capacity, or general airway discomfort from environmental exposures.

**How long does it take to work?** Most users notice initial improvements in 2–4 weeks. Full effects typically develop over 4–8 weeks of consistent use. A 90–180 day course is recommended for sustained respiratory support.

**Is LungFresh FDA approved?** LungFresh is a dietary supplement, not a drug. It is manufactured in a GMP-certified, FDA-registered facility. These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

**Where is LungFresh available?** Exclusively through authorized online channels. Not sold in Walmart, GNC, CVS, Amazon, eBay, or any retail store.
